content: {"praised":["Fresh take on Sherlock with new characters and plot.","Strong acting performances by the cast.","Engaging, easy-to-follow storyline.","Maintains viewer interest throughout.","Good portrayal of young Holmes and Watson."],"criticized":["Lacks proper deduction and observation by Holmes.","Poor revisionist approach, fails to honor original character.","Seamy, gratuitous excess, revolting tone.","Story feels like Conan the Barbarian, not Sherlock.","Characters act impulsively, irrationally, incompetently."]}
